limits: A roast is not safe merely because a famous room laughs; consent, power, privacy and the target’s ability to decline matter.
Celebrity success stories can hide money, networks, luck, timing, health, family support and survivorship bias.
Naming a spouse’s sacrifice can honor hidden labor or romanticize unequal expectations.
Supporters contribute in different ways; a credit map must not turn support into ownership of a person’s career.
Ceremonies can pressure people to perform gratitude, emotion or forgiveness; public appreciation does not require private disclosure.
Film, career, family, financial and institutional claims were not independently verified.
No independent performance, privacy, labor, disability, relationship or anti-harassment reviewer tested this analysis.
The same analyst completed the review.
video_findings.next_test: Compare emotional route, safe teasing, public-image/private-substance, multi-voice portrait, play-to-honor pivot, gratitude-as-lesson, credit layers, dream-to-place, support-as-catch, hidden labor, children-as-present and audience reciprocity with a workplace award, disabled or neurodivergent creator’s milestone, family celebration, community organizer, junior worker receiving public praise and a person who does not want to be roasted or named. Test consent, specific praise, distributed credit, hidden labor without debt, privacy and genuine audience reciprocity; add independent performance, privacy, labor, disability, relationship and anti-harassment review.

video_findings.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | THIERRY HENRY: It’s Not Just a Game (English Subtitles)
video_findings.coverage: All 267 retained captions / 2,732 stored queue words read in order in consecutive transcript chunks. Transcript-only interview analysis; speaker labels, recognition errors, personal claims and audiovisual delivery were not independently validated.

observed_functions.reason: Exceptional-player framing is redirected to group support, trust, honesty and useful argument.

observed_functions.function: Contribution judged by consequence and reset
observed_functions.reason: Goals are evaluated inside the game, past success becomes learning material and the next day becomes a fresh race.
Childhood play stays ordinary; work, tools, coach-ready contribution and uncertainty replace destiny.

observed_functions.function: Mentor unlocks agency and repairs questions
observed_functions.reason: Wenger is credited with mental opening, freedom and question repair; Thierry still has to act and adapt.
Direct correction is tied to team aims and expected in both directions, while delivery remains a safety concern.
Extraordinary players are separated from Bergkamp’s daily commitment, simple execution and training discipline.
Pundit criticism is tied to game evidence, personal attack is separated, and Arsenal history is acknowledged as a complication.

observed_relations.claim: Praise for an exceptional individual is widened into a group account of possibility, trust and honest disagreement.
A count of goals is subordinated to game consequence, then past achievement is converted into a present-tense next race.
A mentor opens mental freedom; the learner expresses that opening by asking better coordination questions and adapting movement.
Team-purpose directness is made reciprocal, with an explicit acknowledgment that emotional delivery may still be poor.
Repeatable training simplicity becomes a standard for later commentary, where judgments should stay with observable game action.

candidate_job_forms.closing: Return to the point; name the limit or next step; release the turn.
candidate_job_forms.contrast_or_disagreement: Name the earlier view; identify what changed; state the present view and remaining overlap.
candidate_job_forms.qualification_or_boundary: State the main claim; name its evidence status or condition; say what would change it.
candidate_job_forms.question: Ask one specific question; give context; allow a genuine answer or opt-out.
candidate_job_forms.reflection_or_value_frame: Describe the event; name the value it raises; distinguish interpretation from verified fact.
candidate_job_forms.story_or_personal_experience: Give a bounded scene; say what it changed or illustrates; state what it cannot prove.
candidate_job_forms.transition_or_structure: Close the current point; name the relationship; enter the next point.

boundary_cases.issue: Greatest-player, impossible, winning and group-trust claims are interview content; captions cannot verify ranking, causality or team safety.
Goal-value and daily-reset principles are personal standards, not universal performance or wellbeing guidance.
Childhood, coaching, career access and Wenger relationship claims are personal recollection; mentor access and structural conditions are not measured.
Purpose-bound candor can be constructive or coercive; captions cannot establish consent, power, repair or whether teammates were safe.
Player rankings and training judgments are subjective and football-specific; “not human” is treated as hyperbole, not fact.
Pundit impartiality, Arsenal allegiance and claims about former colleagues or bosses are not independently verified.
Closing thanks provide no independent evidence of audience response or interview impact.

limits: No audiovisual delivery, body language, timing, audience response or independent speaker-label validation.
Football, career, coaching, family and personal-history claims were not independently verified.
The transcript cannot determine whether directness was safe, effective or equally available to all teammates.
High-performance reset language must not be used to promote burnout, coercion, harassment or unsafe play.
The same analyst completed the review.
video_findings.next_test: Compare shared-credit reframes, consequence-over-count metrics, fresh-race resets, mentor-enabled agency, right-question adaptation, reciprocal candor, simple-under-pressure craft and role-change bias disclosure with a junior worker, disabled athlete, women’s team captain, care-worker, coach, referee, declared-allegiance analyst and person leaving a high-pressure team. Test access, rest, dissent safety, accessibility, fair metrics, labor boundaries and adaptation versus unequal burden; add independent performance, labor, disability, sports-safety and organizational-culture review.

video_findings.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | JOE BIDEN: Victory Speech (English Subtitles)
video_findings.coverage: All 171 retained captions / 1,809 stored queue words read in order in consecutive transcript chunks. Transcript-only political victory-speech analysis; quoted hymn lyrics, public claims, historical comparisons, family accounts and audiovisual delivery were not independently validated.

observed_functions.reason: Local acknowledgments, result, humility, unity pledge and national purpose establish shared ownership and future duty.
Family gratitude moves to educator identity, historic vice-presidential representation and possibility.
Poll workers, volunteers and diverse coalition members receive named credit and become an administration model.
Disappointment is acknowledged, temperature lowered and opponents recast as Americans rather than enemies.
A broad mandate list is anchored in advisers, an action blueprint, science, compassion and pandemic control.
Party identity is retained while governing scope widens and Congress is invited into a named choice.
Historical precedents orient the present; better angels, possibilities and concrete futures build a shared horizon.
Beau, the pandemic dead and a hymn create solace before the speech returns to united work and remembered family instruction.

observed_relations.claim: A result is reframed as shared labor and a governing responsibility rather than a candidate’s private triumph.
Opponent dehumanization is rejected, then healing becomes a list of public problems and a first operational mechanism.
Cooperation is made a present decision, then the decision is placed inside a chain of national inflection points.
Abstract national possibility is interrupted by personal loss and pandemic grief, then returned to collective care.
A compact family instruction closes the speech by handing continued faith and work back to the public.

candidate_job_forms.callback_or_repetition: Introduce a meaningful anchor; return to it with a new application; avoid merely repeating it.
candidate_job_forms.correction_or_reframe: Acknowledge the starting frame; explain the correction; answer the more useful question.
candidate_job_forms.credit_or_acknowledgment: Name the contribution; connect it to the result; state what remains owed or unfinished.
candidate_job_forms.definition_or_explanation: Name the term; give its plain meaning; show one example and one boundary.
candidate_job_forms.transition_or_structure: Close the current point; name the relationship; enter the next point.

boundary_cases.issue: Vote totals, victory framing, unity and soul-of-country claims are speech content, not independently audited electoral or civic facts.
Family roles, representation, coalition breadth and historical significance are attributed claims; category lists can omit voices and flatten differences.
Citizen reframing and healing may invite repair or pressure people to move on; captions cannot establish consent, accountability or reception.
Pandemic, policy, science, cooperation and mandate claims were not independently verified; a named plan is not an outcome.
Historical analogies, moral-universe language and possibility claims are rhetorical frames, not proof of equivalence or feasibility.
Beau, pandemic loss, religion and hymn use involve private grief and cultural context; no emotion or audience effect is inferred.
Closing faith language and military blessing provide no independent evidence of action, unity or listener understanding.

limits: No audiovisual delivery, vocal, musical, audience, timing or performance review.
Electoral, public-health, historical, policy, family and religious claims were not independently verified.
Coalition breadth and unity language can omit disagreement, power differences or affected groups.
Healing and cooperation language must not erase accountability, protest, grief or legitimate conflict.
Quoted hymn lyrics are treated only as transcript evidence; product reuse requires copyright review.
The same analyst completed the review.
video_findings.next_test: Compare victory-to-stewardship, coalition credit, opponent-to-citizen reframing, mandate-to-mechanism, choice-with-constraints, inflection-point analogy, value repetition and grief-to-handoff with a concession speech, losing candidate, community organizer after violence, public-health briefing, first-time leader and speaker rejecting reconciliation language. Test coalition completeness, mechanism specificity, analogy limits, grief consent, accessibility, actual next-action recall and choice versus structural constraint; add independent political, historical, disability, trauma, privacy, religious and accessibility review.
